gravity_sign_controls.case: Output gravity alone equals nominal rest spring; equality rejects restart

assumptions: Quasistatic taut inextensible core on the validated forward guide branch; housing end seats do not move.
Catalog linear spring model F0+k*extension; actual force/rate/initial tension are not measured.
Each direction has its own load-dependent efficiency; direction efficiencies need not be equal.

R is TOTAL adverse output-side generalized force excluding spring, including adverse gravity/external loads; D is additional input-side wire-equivalent drag not already in eta; tau is TOTAL adverse input generalized torque including pivot resistance and adverse gravity/external torque; H is residual horizontal finger resistance.

Gravity varies with whole-device orientation and input angle. R and tau must be evaluated at every stroke and intended device pose. Ignoring assisting gravity is conservative; adverse gravity must not be omitted or counted twice in measured totals.
Do not count the same cable/guide loss both in eta and D. Dynamic inertia, impact, hysteresis, jam loads and compliance are not solved.

definitions.p: Hypothetical extra spring installed extension; NOT the M6 cable adjustment and not an implemented independent preload control.

gravity_and_external_load_contract.coordinates: Q_u is positive along increasing output u (CAD +Z); Q_theta is positive along increasing solver theta (actual input rotation about CAD -Y). Both depend on whole-device pose and may depend on u.

signed_gravity_definitions.output: Q_u_g = sum_i m_i * g_vector dot d(r_i)/du, N; use consistent length units in the displacement Jacobian.
signed_gravity_definitions.input: Q_theta_g = sum_j m_j * g_vector dot d(r_j)/dtheta, N mm when r is in mm; for rigid rotation, sum_j (r_j cross m_j*g_vector) dot e_theta.

conservative_direction_totals.scope: Adding only adverse signed components conservatively discards gravity assistance. Directly measured total direction/pose loads can be used instead; do not add gravity again to such totals.

unknown_mass_bounds.pure_output_translation: For mass M_z rigidly translating one-to-one along CAD Z, abs(Q_u_g)<=M_z*g (N). Worst-case adverse R_g<=M_z*g.
unknown_mass_bounds.input_rotation: abs(Q_theta_g)<=g*sum_j(m_j*r_perp_j) (N mm, r_perp in mm); for one rigid input assembly use M_input*g*r_COM_perp.
unknown_mass_bounds.other_moving_parts: Do not apply M*g blindly to cam-driven radial pieces, changing-shape springs or cable. General bound abs(Q_u_g)<=g*sum_i(m_i*norm(d(r_i)/du)); their generalized loads need their own Jacobians or measured total resistance.
unknown_mass_bounds.no_estimate: Masses, centers of mass, actual gravity orientation and external load values have not been supplied or inferred from density/STL volume.

gravity_and_external_load_contract.robust_return_condition: Require both return inequalities for every u in [0,20] and every intended whole-device pose using total R and tau, or conservative pointwise upper envelopes.
gravity_and_external_load_contract.nominal_zero_worst_pose_symbolic_boundar: D + (tau_other + g*sum_j(m_j*r_perp_j))/60 + H/(5/3) < eta_return*(2.975 - R_other - M_z*g - R_other_moving_gravity_bound); right side must be positive. Nonnegative worst-case bounds may be conservative because load extrema need not occur in the same pose.
gravity_and_external_load_contract.zero_position_limit: The prior u=0 weakest-position proof applies only to constant nonnegative TOTAL R,D,H,tau and constant eta. Angle/pose-dependent gravity can shift the weakest position; no endpoint-only actual return guarantee.
gravity_and_external_load_contract.sufficiency_scope: With exact nonnegative resisting inputs the original inequalities are the positive-surplus test in the assumed taut quasistatic model. Replacing signed loads with adverse-only clips or separate worst-direction bounds yields a conservative sufficient budget within that model. Failure of this conservative budget does NOT prove physical inability to return: discarded assistance or overconservative simultaneous bounds can matter.
gravity_and_external_load_contract.numeric_tables_scope: Existing force/efficiency tables and plots keep their stated zero-other-load assumptions; they do not include a measured or assumed gravity load.

formulas.return_required: Fs>R_return AND torque_margin>0 at EVERY stroke and intended pose is the positive-surplus test for exact nonnegative resisting loads in the assumed taut quasistatic model. With adverse-only clipping/upper bounds it is a conservative sufficient budget, not a necessary physical condition; failed bounds are inconclusive. Equality does not guarantee breakaway.
formulas.return_eta_lower: (D_return + tau_return/A + H/rho)/(Fs-R_return), provided Fs>R_return; eta must strictly exceed this and be <=1.
formulas.preload_extra_extension_lower_mm: sup_(u,intended_device_pose)[(R_return + (D_return+tau_return/A+H/rho)/eta_return - Fs_at_p0)/k], using TOTAL adverse loads
formulas.preload_feasible_interval: p>=-e0; p strictly above return lower bound; p<=all catalog upper bounds and any supplied finger-force upper bound. Empty interval means those supplied demands are incompatible.

continuous_domain_findings.conditional_weakest_return_position: u=0 only for constant nonnegative TOTAL R,D,H,tau and constant eta. With position/pose-dependent gravity, external loads, friction, ball loads or efficiency the full pointwise condition is necessary; no endpoint-only actual guarantee.
continuous_domain_findings.proof: 0<=phi_prime<=1 and0<=beta<=theta imply dA/du>=-tan(theta_max); d(A*Fs)/du>=k*R*cos(theta_max)-Fs_max*tan(theta_max)>0. A and B are nonincreasing, so subtracting constant nonnegative A*(eta*R+D) and B*H cannot create a weaker endpoint.

nominal_zero.input_pivot_torque_budget_Nmm: 178.5*eta_return only when other resisting loads are zero
nominal_zero.horizontal_finger_resistance_budget_N: 4.958333333333333*eta_return only when other resisting loads are zero

stop_compatibility.current_nominal: Input20/output20 coincide only in the continuous-circle contact approximation with coordinated taut zero and zero incremental loss. Actual72-gon first contact is separately accounted for below.
stop_compatibility.with_lost_travel: For nonnegative net lost travel ell, requested output=max(0,U-ell). Full20 at ell_max needs U>=20+ell_max; avoiding input overpull against output hard stop at ell_min needs U<=20+ell_min.
stop_compatibility.incompatibility: This addresses the stricter artificial exact20 target only: if ell_max>ell_min no fixed stop can satisfy both exact demands without a separately validated allowance/load limiter or a relaxed endpoint target. It does NOT invalidate the nonempty functional single-ball-release endpoint window below. Output hard stop prevents travel, but continued pull creates unbudgeted load, not extra useful stroke.
stop_compatibility.no_loss_stop_22: 2mm extra input demand after output20 is not allowed output stroke; no spring/strength evaluation of that overpull is claimed.
stop_compatibility.slack_return: If core slack appears before input zero, output spring cannot push the core to complete the final input return. There is no separate input return spring.

source_bound_functional_stop_window.scope: Inherited conditional static gate envelope with stated Bx=1; not a measured tolerance or dynamic one-ball feeding guarantee.
strict_stop_inequalities: Feasible iff ell_max-ell_min < H_min-u_release; inequalities are strict for positive clearance.
source_bound_functional_stop_window.ell_definition: Net input takeup minus output displacement at full pull, including bounded slack/stretch/zero-reference errors; separate any uncertainty in H_min.

circular_vs_polygon_contact.scope: First contact of the specified local lever-web/stop pair only. It does not prove absence of earlier collisions with other assemblies. The existing system report covers its own sampled 0..20 domain; numerical roots slightly above20 and near22 are local diagnostic continuations, not permitted assembled travel.
circular_vs_polygon_contact.continuous_first_contact_argument: Before the circular target angle the origin-to-knuckle web lies to the right of its decreasing circular minimum-X bound. Until atan(5/16) the lower web extends toward +X, and above that angle its clipped-band left reach is less than 5.21 mm from the knuckle versus at least 5.4947 for the larger knuckle. At target angles 16..22 the supporting 72-gon vertex Y offset is <=5.5*sin(2.5deg)=.2399, below the minimum screw-end band margin .26775 (and remains below it through the .01380-u delay). Thus the contact root is the first contact in this local stop geometry, not just a sampled overlap.
circular_vs_polygon_contact.meaning: Circular formula is nominal; inscribed web can delay actual first contact by up to this small design discretization amount. Target screw end disk still covers the supporting vertex.

source_bound_functional_stop_window.setup_not_prescribed: Actual loss, phase and hard-stop uncertainty must fit the functional window before a setting is selected. This report does not prescribe a stop setting.

route_loss_context.interpretation: Geometric bend only. No friction coefficient, capstan efficiency, additive drag or stability of the two free housing bends is inferred.

physical_inputs_still_needed: Actual selected spring force versus installed length, including initial tension and hysteresis.
Output-side total breakaway/drag versus stroke with the intended balls, airflow state and intended device orientations; adverse gravity/external load must be included, not optionally omitted.

Actual moving masses and centers of mass plus intended device poses, OR measured total directional loads covering those poses; include input assembly gravity torque and cam/spring/core generalized gravity where material.
Forward and reverse input/output cable force transfer, with actual ferrule seats, route and guide; or an equivalent measured loss envelope, avoiding double counting.
Input bearing breakaway torque after assembly, core slack/compliance and stop/zero repeatability.
Permitted user finger force and proven cable/clamp/printed load capacities; none has been invented.
